csv_agency: State of California Department of General Services
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of General Services (DGS), Real Estate Services Division (RESD), Project Management and Development Branch (PMDB) is requesting Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from Construction Project Management Services firms for the project listed below The 10th and O Streets State Office Building, located at 1021 O Street in Sacramento, is a 10-story, approximately 480,000 gross square foot facility and was constructed to serve as a temporary swing space for the Governor s Office and the Legislature during development of the State Capitol Annex. Current occupants are expected to vacate the building in early 2028, creating an opportunity to optimize the facility for long-term state use.

short_description: Reconfiguration and refurbishment of a 10-story Sacramento state office building.

services: Statement of Qualifications for Construction Project Management Services. Requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing office building refurbishment rather than a new structurally ambitious project.
- Focus is on construction project management services, not core structural design.
- Building type is an administrative/state office building, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Large size (about 480,000 GSF) and inclusion of structural engineering provide minor strategic relevance.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice is for construction project management services and lists multiple disciplines, but does not state design fee, structural fee share, or compensation basis.
references_qualifications: SOQ requested from Construction Project Management Services firms. Specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text. Disciplines requested include structural engineering and multiple building design/management fields.
